label: GO step after a reward run, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (100% of mass with prev_reward==1; never after no reward). It is strongly confined to the first ~25-40 trials of an episode (none past trial ~45; 92% of mass before trial 25). Requiring that the 2 trials before that were also not unrewarded (a reward run) helps a little (dev F1 0.39 vs 0.32 for GO & prev_reward & ep_trial<25). It does not care about choice, state, transition type, or stay/switch. Precision stays low (~25%): it fires in only about half the episodes, so some episode-level history that the 5-trial window cannot see seems to gate it. In the examples, activation grows across consecutive rewarded trials and peaks when the GO choice is confident (large |choice logit|); I did not measure this ramp quantitatively. All variables in the predicate are observed.
